An '''unidentified Z-10 Seeker''' was shot down as the [[Hand of Judgment]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] avoided roaming patrols on [[Shelkonwa]].<ref name="Allegiance" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Z-10 Seeker appeared in the [[2007]] novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']] by author [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Allegiance" />
